```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(Metrics)
library(forecast)
library(pls)
```


```{r}
data = read.csv("../data/data_merged.csv")
data_mean = read.csv("../data/prevail_mean.csv")

data$date <- as.Date(data$date)
data_mean$date <- as.Date(data_mean$date)

# ============================================================================
# CREATE MULTI-HORIZON TARGET VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
# We want to forecast 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month ahead returns
# 6-month = sum of 2 consecutive quarters
# 12-month = sum of 4 consecutive quarters

data <- data %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create lead log returns for each horizon
    log_ret_lead_3m = lead(log_ret, 1),           # 3-month ahead (1 quarter)
    log_ret_lead_6m = lead(log_ret, 1) + lead(log_ret, 2),  # 6-month ahead (2 quarters)
    log_ret_lead_12m = lead(log_ret, 1) + lead(log_ret, 2) + lead(log_ret, 3) + lead(log_ret, 4)  # 12-month ahead (4 quarters)
  )

# ============================================================================
# CREATE LAGGED VARIABLES FOR MULTI-HORIZON TARGETS
# ============================================================================
# Create 5 lags for each horizon's returns

# Lags for 3-month returns
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    log_ret_3m_L1 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 1),
    log_ret_3m_L2 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 2),
    log_ret_3m_L3 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 3),
    log_ret_3m_L4 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 4),
    log_ret_3m_L5 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 5)
  )

# ============================================================================
# SELECT FINAL FEATURES FOR MODELING
# ============================================================================

# Get all column names and identify lagged variables
all_cols <- names(data)

# Select L2-L5 lagged variables (excluding the log_ret_3m lags we just created)
lagged_L2_L5 <- grep("_L[2-5]$", all_cols, value = TRUE)
# Exclude the log_ret_3m lags from this list since we'll add them explicitly
lagged_L2_L5 <- setdiff(lagged_L2_L5, c("log_ret_3m_L2", "log_ret_3m_L3", "log_ret_3m_L4", "log_ret_3m_L5"))

# Also get price_fd_L1
price_fd_L1_col <- grep("^price_fd_L1$", all_cols, value = TRUE)

# Build final dataset
data <- data %>%
  select(
    date,
    log_ret,
    # Multi-horizon targets
    log_ret_lead_3m,
    log_ret_lead_6m,
    log_ret_lead_12m,
    # Lagged multi-horizon returns (5 lags)
    log_ret_3m_L1,
    log_ret_3m_L2,
    log_ret_3m_L3,
    log_ret_3m_L4,
    log_ret_3m_L5,
    # Lagged features from original data
    all_of(price_fd_L1_col),
    all_of(lagged_L2_L5)
  )

cat("\n=== Multi-Horizon Target Variables Created ===\n")
cat("✓ log_ret_lead_3m: 3-month ahead returns (1 quarter)\n")
cat("✓ log_ret_lead_6m: 6-month ahead returns (sum of 2 quarters)\n")
cat("✓ log_ret_lead_12m: 12-month ahead returns (sum of 4 quarters)\n")
cat("✓ 5 lags created for each horizon\n")

# ============================================================================
# REMOVE NA VALUES (ONLY LAGGED AND LEAD VARIABLES)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== Removing NA Values ===\n")
cat("Observations before drop_na():", nrow(data), "\n")

# Remove all rows with any NA values
data_clean <- data %>%
  drop_na()

cat("Observations after drop_na():", nrow(data_clean), "\n")
cat("Rows removed:", nrow(data) - nrow(data_clean), "\n\n")

# Show date range of clean data
cat("Date range of clean dataset:\n")
cat("  From:", as.character(min(data_clean$date)), "\n")
cat("  To:  ", as.character(max(data_clean$date)), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# TRAIN/TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================================

set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(data_clean)
train_size <- floor(0.8 * n)
test_size  <- n - train_size

train_data <- data_clean[1:train_size, ]
test_data  <- data_clean[(train_size + 1):n, ]

cat("\n=== Train/Test Split ===\n")
cat("Total observations:", n, "\n")
cat("Training set:", train_size, "\n")
cat("Test set:", test_size, "\n")
```

# ============================================================================
# PRINCIPAL COMPONENT REGRESSION - 3-MONTH HORIZON (RECURSIVE CV)
# ============================================================================

```{r}
cat("\n=== Building PCR Model for 3-Month Horizon with Recursive CV ===\n")

# Prepare data for PCR (3-month)
pcr_train_3m <- train_data %>%
  select(-date, -log_ret, -log_ret_lead_6m, -log_ret_lead_12m)

pcr_test_3m <- test_data %>%
  select(-date, -log_ret, -log_ret_lead_6m, -log_ret_lead_12m)

# Set up recursive (expanding window) cross-validation
n_train <- nrow(pcr_train_3m)
min_train_size <- 60  # Minimum training size
n_folds <- n_train - min_train_size  # Number of CV iterations

cat("Training observations:", n_train, "\n")
cat("Minimum training size:", min_train_size, "\n")
cat("Number of CV folds:", n_folds, "\n")

# Create custom segments for recursive CV (expanding window)
cv_segments <- list()
for (i in 1:n_folds) {
  # Training: observations 1 to (min_train_size + i - 1)
  # Validation: observation (min_train_size + i)
  cv_segments[[i]] <- (min_train_size + i)
}

# Fit PCR model with recursive CV
pcr_model_3m <- pcr(log_ret_lead_3m ~ ., 
                     data = pcr_train_3m, 
                     scale = TRUE, 
                     validation = "CV",
                     segments = cv_segments)

# Determine optimal number of components
cv_results_3m <- RMSEP(pcr_model_3m, estimate = "CV")
optimal_ncomp_3m <- which.min(cv_results_3m$val[1, 1, ]) - 1
# Ensure at least 1 component is used
optimal_ncomp_3m <- max(1, optimal_ncomp_3m)

cat("Optimal number of components (3-month):", optimal_ncomp_3m, "\n")

# Make predictions for 3-month horizon
train_pred_3m <- as.vector(predict(pcr_model_3m, newdata = pcr_train_3m, ncomp = optimal_ncomp_3m))
test_pred_3m <- as.vector(predict(pcr_model_3m, newdata = pcr_test_3m, ncomp = optimal_ncomp_3m))
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== Model Performance Metrics ===\n")
```

# ============================================================================
# DIEBOLD-MARIANO TEST VS PREVAILING MEAN
# ============================================================================

```{r}
cat("\n=== Diebold-Mariano Test: PCR vs Prevailing Mean ===\n")

# Merge prevailing mean predictions with test data
test_with_mean <- test_data %>%
  select(date) %>%
  left_join(data_mean %>% select(date, mean_prevailing_ret), by = "date")

# Check if we have prevailing mean data
if (all(is.na(test_with_mean$mean_prevailing_ret))) {
  cat("Warning: No prevailing mean data found for test period.\n")
  cat("Using historical mean of log_ret as baseline instead.\n")
  
  # Use historical mean as benchmark
  historical_mean <- mean(train_data$log_ret, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_pred_3m <- rep(historical_mean, nrow(test_data))
  mean_pred_6m <- rep(historical_mean * 2, nrow(test_data))
  mean_pred_12m <- rep(historical_mean * 4, nrow(test_data))
} else {
  # Use prevailing mean predictions
  mean_pred_3m <- test_with_mean$mean_prevailing_ret
  mean_pred_6m <- test_with_mean$mean_prevailing_ret * 2  # Approximate scaling
  mean_pred_12m <- test_with_mean$mean_prevailing_ret * 4  # Approximate scaling
}

# Calculate forecast errors for 3-month horizon
pcr_errors_3m <- test_data$log_ret_lead_3m - test_pred_3m
mean_errors_3m <- test_data$log_ret_lead_3m - mean_pred_3m

# Calculate forecast errors for 6-month horizon
pcr_errors_6m <- test_data$log_ret_lead_6m - test_pred_6m
mean_errors_6m <- test_data$log_ret_lead_6m - mean_pred_6m

# Calculate forecast errors for 12-month horizon
pcr_errors_12m <- test_data$log_ret_lead_12m - test_pred_12m
mean_errors_12m <- test_data$log_ret_lead_12m - mean_pred_12m

# DM Test for 3-Month Horizon
cat("\n--- 3-Month Horizon DM Test ---\n")
if (length(na.omit(pcr_errors_3m)) >= 2 && length(na.omit(mean_errors_3m)) >= 2) {
  dm_test_3m <- dm.test(pcr_errors_3m, mean_errors_3m, alternative = "less", h = 1)
  print(dm_test_3m)
  if (dm_test_3m$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("PCR significantly outperforms Prevailing Mean (p < 0.05)\n")
  } else if (dm_test_3m$p.value < 0.10) {
    cat("~ PCR marginally outperforms Prevailing Mean (p < 0.10)\n")
  } else {
    cat("No significant difference between PCR and Prevailing Mean\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for DM test\n")
}

# DM Test for 6-Month Horizon
cat("\n--- 6-Month Horizon DM Test ---\n")
if (length(na.omit(pcr_errors_6m)) >= 2 && length(na.omit(mean_errors_6m)) >= 2) {
  dm_test_6m <- dm.test(pcr_errors_6m, mean_errors_6m, alternative = "less", h = 2)
  print(dm_test_6m)
  if (dm_test_6m$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("PCR significantly outperforms Prevailing Mean (p < 0.05)\n")
  } else if (dm_test_6m$p.value < 0.10) {
    cat("~ PCR marginally outperforms Prevailing Mean (p < 0.10)\n")
  } else {
    cat("No significant difference between PCR and Prevailing Mean\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for DM test\n")
}

# DM Test for 12-Month Horizon
cat("\n--- 12-Month Horizon DM Test ---\n")
if (length(na.omit(pcr_errors_12m)) >= 2 && length(na.omit(mean_errors_12m)) >= 2) {
  dm_test_12m <- dm.test(pcr_errors_12m, mean_errors_12m, alternative = "less", h = 4)
  print(dm_test_12m)
  if (dm_test_12m$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("PCR significantly outperforms Prevailing Mean (p < 0.05)\n")
  } else if (dm_test_12m$p.value < 0.10) {
    cat("~ PCR marginally outperforms Prevailing Mean (p < 0.10)\n")
  } else {
    cat("No significant difference between PCR and Prevailing Mean\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for DM test\n")
}

# Summary comparison table
cat("\n=== Performance Comparison: PCR vs Prevailing Mean ===\n")
comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Horizon = c("3-Month", "6-Month", "12-Month"),
  PCR_RMSE = c(rmse_test_3m, rmse_test_6m, rmse_test_12m),
  Mean_RMSE = c(
    rmse(test_data$log_ret_lead_3m, mean_pred_3m),
    rmse(test_data$log_ret_lead_6m, mean_pred_6m),
    rmse(test_data$log_ret_lead_12m, mean_pred_12m)
  ),
  PCR_R2 = c(r2_test_3m, r2_test_6m, r2_test_12m)
)
comparison_table$RMSE_Improvement <- 
  (comparison_table$Mean_RMSE - comparison_table$PCR_RMSE) / comparison_table$Mean_RMSE * 100

print(comparison_table)
```

# ============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION: PCR vs PREVAILING MEAN vs ACTUAL
# ============================================================================

```{r}
cat("\n=== Creating Visualization Plots ===\n")

# Prepare data for plotting
plot_data <- data.frame(
  date = test_data$date,
  actual_3m = test_data$log_ret_lead_3m,
  pcr_3m = test_pred_3m,
  mean_3m = mean_pred_3m,
  actual_6m = test_data$log_ret_lead_6m,
  pcr_6m = test_pred_6m,
  mean_6m = mean_pred_6m,
  actual_12m = test_data$log_ret_lead_12m,
  pcr_12m = test_pred_12m,
  mean_12m = mean_pred_12m
)

# Plot 1: 3-Month Horizon Time Series
p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual_3m, color = "Actual"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pcr_3m, color = "PCR"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_3m, color = "Prevailing Mean"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black", "PCR" = "blue", "Prevailing Mean" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "3-Month Horizon: PCR vs Prevailing Mean vs Actual",
    subtitle = paste0("Test Set Performance (R² = ", round(r2_test_3m, 4), ")"),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Log Return",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p1)

# Plot 2: 6-Month Horizon Time Series
p2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual_6m, color = "Actual"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pcr_6m, color = "PCR"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_6m, color = "Prevailing Mean"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black", "PCR" = "blue", "Prevailing Mean" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "6-Month Horizon: PCR vs Prevailing Mean vs Actual",
    subtitle = paste0("Test Set Performance (R² = ", round(r2_test_6m, 4), ")"),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Log Return",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p2)

# Plot 3: 12-Month Horizon Time Series
p3 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual_12m, color = "Actual"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pcr_12m, color = "PCR"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_12m, color = "Prevailing Mean"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black", "PCR" = "blue", "Prevailing Mean" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "12-Month Horizon: PCR vs Prevailing Mean vs Actual",
    subtitle = paste0("Test Set Performance (R² = ", round(r2_test_12m, 4), ")"),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Log Return",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p3)

# Plot 4: Scatter Plots - Actual vs Predicted (3 panels)
p4_3m <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = pcr_3m, y = actual_3m)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(
    title = "3-Month Horizon",
    x = "PCR Predicted",
    y = "Actual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p4_6m <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = pcr_6m, y = actual_6m)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(
    title = "6-Month Horizon",
    x = "PCR Predicted",
    y = "Actual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p4_12m <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = pcr_12m, y = actual_12m)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(
    title = "12-Month Horizon",
    x = "PCR Predicted",
    y = "Actual"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Combine scatter plots
library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(p4_3m, p4_6m, p4_12m, ncol = 3,
             top = "Actual vs PCR Predicted Returns (Test Set)")

# Plot 5: Residuals Over Time
plot_data$residual_3m <- plot_data$actual_3m - plot_data$pcr_3m
plot_data$residual_6m <- plot_data$actual_6m - plot_data$pcr_6m
plot_data$residual_12m <- plot_data$actual_12m - plot_data$pcr_12m

p5 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(aes(y = residual_3m, color = "3-Month"), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = residual_6m, color = "6-Month"), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = residual_12m, color = "12-Month"), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("3-Month" = "blue", "6-Month" = "green", "12-Month" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "PCR Forecast Residuals Over Time",
    subtitle = "Actual - Predicted (All Horizons)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Residual",
    color = "Horizon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p5)

# Plot 6: Error Distribution Comparison
plot_data$pcr_error_3m <- abs(plot_data$residual_3m)
plot_data$mean_error_3m <- abs(plot_data$actual_3m - plot_data$mean_3m)

p6 <- ggplot(plot_data) +
  geom_density(aes(x = pcr_error_3m, fill = "PCR"), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(aes(x = mean_error_3m, fill = "Prevailing Mean"), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("PCR" = "blue", "Prevailing Mean" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Absolute Error Distribution: PCR vs Prevailing Mean",
    subtitle = "3-Month Horizon (Test Set)",
    x = "Absolute Error",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p6)

cat("\n✓ All plots generated successfully\n")
```
